definitions.explanation: The act of staying somewhere overnight, typically at a hotel or inn.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一泊|いっぱく}→一泊：08892_ippaku⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I stayed one night in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧8,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The accommodation fee is 8,000 yen including breakfast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦サイト→サイト：05603_saito⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}びたい→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for accommodations on a travel website. I want to choose a place with high review ratings.

notes:
{宿泊|しゅくはく} refers to lodging or staying overnight at a hotel, inn, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to stay overnight, to lodge)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to book accommodation)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ / {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (accommodation fee)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧ (lodging facility)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧ (place to stay)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (hotel guest)
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (accommodation reservation)
- ⟦{素泊|すどま}り→素泊まり：07048_sudomari⟧{宿泊|しゅくはく} (room only, no meals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {宿泊|しゅくはく}: lodging (formal term)
- ⟦{泊|と}まる→泊まる：10445_tomaru⟧: to stay (casual verb)
- ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧: lodging, inn (traditional word)
